# mdBook

## Detect

- `book.toml` with a `[book]` table. Only mdBook uses it, so it wins over every other signal.
- `SUMMARY.md` in the source dir (`[book] src`, default `src/`). GitBook and HonKit also use `SUMMARY.md`, but with `book.json` or `.gitbook.yaml` and no `book.toml`.
- `mdbook build`, `mdbook test` or `cargo install mdbook-<plugin>` in CI.

## Get the source

### From the repo

- Chapters live under `[book] src`, which can point outside the book root. Only chapters listed in `SUMMARY.md` publish; every non-Markdown file under `src` is copied to the site.
- Build: `mdbook build -d <dir>` (`mint migrate --topic discovery`, From the repo).

### From an export

None; the book is built from the repo.

### From the live site

The rendered sidebar gives chapters, order and part titles; `print.html` holds every chapter. Sources come from `git-repository-url` or `edit-url-template`.

## Config → docs.json

| book.toml                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           | docs.json                                                                              |
| ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `[book] title` / `description`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      | `name` / `description`                                                                 |
| `[book] logo` (relative to `src`)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   | `logo`                                                                                 |
| `[output.html] git-repository-url`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  | `navbar.links` (`type: github` for GitHub)                                             |
| `default-theme` and `preferred-dark-theme` both dark (`coal`, `navy`, `ayu`)                                                                                                                                                                                        | `appearance.default: "dark"`                                                           |
| `additional-css` / `additional-js`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  | (`mint migrate --topic navigation`, Chrome); also delete admonish assets               |
| `google-analytics`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  | `integrations.ga4.measurementId`                                                       |
| `[output.html.redirect]`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            | `redirects` (URLs below)                                                               |
| `[output.html.fold] enable = false`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 | nested groups `expanded: true`                                                         |
| `site-url`, `cname`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 | none; their host and path are part of every old URL                                    |
| `theme/` folder                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     | report custom templates; a custom favicon → `favicon` (the stock one is mdBook's logo) |
| `authors`, `language`, `edit-url-template`, `mathjax-support`, `input-404`, `no-section-label`, `smart-punctuation`, `[output.html.playground]`, `[output.html.code.hidelines]`, `[output.html.search]`, `[output.html.print]`, `[rust]`, `[build]`, other backends | drop and report                                                                        |

Reference: https://rust-lang.github.io/mdBook/format/configuration/

## Navigation

`SUMMARY.md` is the whole navigation (https://rust-lang.github.io/mdBook/format/summary.html):

- `# Summary` on the first line is ignored.
- Prefix chapters (bare links before the first list) and suffix chapters (bare links after the last list) are unnested pages before and after the numbered chapters.
- Part titles (`# Part`, h1 only) → one group per part.
- Numbered chapters (`-` or `*` items, nested by indentation) → pages; a chapter with children → group with that chapter as `root`.
- Draft chapters `[Title]()` have no file: report as planned chapters.
- Separators (`---`): drop.
- The sidebar label is the `SUMMARY.md` link text; the page heading is the chapter's H1.
- mdBook numbers chapters (`1.`, `2.3.`) unless `no-section-label`. Report prose that cites chapter numbers.

## Content conversion

| mdBook                                                                                                                                                                                                   | Mintlify                                                                                                              |
| -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `{{#include file}}` and `file:2`, `file::10`, `file:2:`, `file:2:10`, `file:anchor` (`ANCHOR:` / `ANCHOR_END:` markers). Paths are relative to the chapter; expanded as text, so they work inside fences | code: (`mint migrate --topic conversion`, Code imports); prose: (`mint migrate --topic conversion`, Reusable content) |
| `{{#rustdoc_include file:sel}}`                                                                                                                                                                          | the selected lines only; report the lost expand toggle                                                                |
| `{{#playground file}}`                                                                                                                                                                                   | a static `rust` fence; report the lost Run button                                                                     |
| `{{#title X}}`                                                                                                                                                                                           | `title`                                                                                                               |
| `\{{#...}}` (escaped, in docs about mdBook)                                                                                                                                                              | literal text in inline code or a fence                                                                                |
| Rust fence attributes (`rust,ignore`, `no_run`, `should_panic`, `compile_fail`, `editable`, `noplayground`, `mdbook-runnable`, `edition20xx`)                                                            | `rust`                                                                                                                |
| hidden lines in Rust fences: first non-space characters `# ` or a lone `#`; `##` is an escaped `#`; `#[` and `#!` are code                                                                               | delete hidden lines                                                                                                   |
| custom hide prefixes (`[output.html.code.hidelines]`, fence `hidelines=<prefix>`)                                                                                                                        | delete those lines too                                                                                                |
| `> [!NOTE]` style alerts                                                                                                                                                                                 | (`mint migrate --topic conversion`, GitHub alerts)                                                                    |
| mdbook-admonish ` ```admonish type ` (`title="..."`, `collapsible=true`); aliases per https://tommilligan.github.io/mdbook-admonish/reference.html                                                       | (`mint migrate --topic conversion`, Admonitions); collapsible → `<Accordion>`                                         |
| mdbook-tabs `{{#tabs}}` / `{{#tab name="X"}}`                                                                                                                                                            | `<Tabs>` / `<Tab>`                                                                                                    |
| MathJax `\\( \\)`, `\\[ \\]`                                                                                                                                                                             | `$ $`, `$$ $$`, with Markdown escapes inside the math undone                                                          |
| mdbook-toc `<!-- toc -->`                                                                                                                                                                                | delete                                                                                                                |
| `## Heading { #id .class }`                                                                                                                                                                              | (`mint migrate --topic conversion`, Heading IDs); drop classes                                                        |
| definition lists (`term` then `: definition`)                                                                                                                                                            | a list or table                                                                                                       |
| `<i class="fa fa-x">`                                                                                                                                                                                    | `<Icon>`                                                                                                              |
| elements with `class="hidden"`                                                                                                                                                                           | delete                                                                                                                |

Reference: https://rust-lang.github.io/mdBook/format/mdbook.html

## Assets

- Non-Markdown files under `src` that chapters reference keep their paths.
- Files included from outside `src` are code, not assets.

## URLs and redirects

- `src/a/b.md` → `/a/b.html` (`mint migrate --topic navigation`, Redirects).
- The built-in `index` preprocessor turns `README.md` chapters into `index.html` (`mint migrate --topic conversion`, Files).
- The first chapter is also written as the book's `/index.html`.
- `[output.html.redirect]` keys are absolute old paths; values are relative or absolute targets. Fragment keys (`/page.html#frag`) cannot be redirect sources: report them.

## Known gaps

- Rust playground, `editable` code, `mdbook test` doctests.
- The hidden-line toggle and `rustdoc_include` expansion.
- Chapter numbering, draft chapters, separators.
- Print page, EPUB and PDF backends.
- Custom preprocessors, cmdrun, i18n-helpers (`po/`), graphviz/plantuml/svgbob diagrams.
- Fragment redirects; heading anchors (`mint migrate --topic conversion`, Heading IDs).
